description: Congolese Air Force two-seat trainer, construction number 10994819 - a number in the Ulan-Ude plant 99 MiG-15UTI series, which supports the type attribution. Coded preserved and sited in the landscaped part of the military enclave on the west side of Pointe-Noire Agostinho-Neto, separate from the withdrawn MiG-21 line 350 m to the north. aviationsmilitaires.net describes the southern display aircraft as a MiG-17 rather than a MiG-15; that page gives no construction number and the disagreement is most likely a loose visual identification on its part, but it is unresolved. Esri imagery of 21 April 2021 for this block is capped at low zoom and shows an aircraft-shaped white object in the display area without allowing a type call.

Congolese Air Force Noratlas, construction number 138, coded preserved and standing about 80 m south-south-east of the MiG. aviationsmilitaires.net independently records a Noratlas preserved in the southern part of Pointe-Noire air base, which corroborates presence and position though not the serial. The twin-boom planform of the white airframe visible in the 21 April 2021 Esri imagery at this position is consistent with a Noratlas.
